# Databricks notebook source
# MAGIC %md # Credit Card Fraud Detection Pipeline

# COMMAND ----------
import pyspark.sql.functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql.types import *
import mlflow
import mlflow.spark
from pyspark.ml import Pipeline
from pyspark.ml.feature import VectorAssembler, StringIndexer
from pyspark.ml.classification import GBTClassifier, RandomForestClassifier
from pyspark.ml.evaluation import BinaryClassificationEvaluator

# COMMAND ----------
CATALOG = "workspace"
SCHEMA = "mlpab3f803c"
VOLUME_PATH = f"/Volumes/{CATALOG}/{SCHEMA}/data_volume"
FG_TABLE = f"{CATALOG}.{SCHEMA}.cctxn739ee9"
TD_TABLE = f"{CATALOG}.{SCHEMA}.cctd739ee9"
PRED_TABLE = f"{CATALOG}.{SCHEMA}.ccpred739ee9"
MODEL_NAME = f"{CATALOG}.{SCHEMA}.ccmodel739ee9"
EXPERIMENT_PATH = f"/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/mlpab3f803c/ccfraud_experiment"

# COMMAND ----------
# Read training data
txn_df = spark.read.option("header", True).option("inferSchema", True).csv(f"{VOLUME_PATH}/transactions.csv")
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("ts", F.to_timestamp("datetime"))
txn_df.printSchema()
txn_df.count()

# COMMAND ----------
# Feature engineering
# 1. Hour of day
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("hour_of_day", F.hour("ts"))

# 2. Day of week
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("day_of_week", F.dayofweek("ts"))

# 3. Transaction count per card in last 24h window (using row_number as proxy for velocity)
window_24h = Window.partitionBy("cc_num").orderBy("ts").rangeBetween(-86400, 0)
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("txn_count_24h", F.count("transaction_id").over(window_24h))

# 4. Sum of amounts per card in last 24h
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("amount_sum_24h", F.sum("amount").over(window_24h))

# 5. Mean amount per card (historical)
window_all = Window.partitionBy("cc_num").orderBy("ts").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, -1)
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("mean_amount_hist", F.mean("amount").over(window_all))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("mean_amount_hist", F.when(F.col("mean_amount_hist").isNull(), F.col("amount")).otherwise(F.col("mean_amount_hist")))

# 6. Amount deviation from mean
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("amount_deviation", F.col("amount") - F.col("mean_amount_hist"))

# 7. Mean lat/long per card (usual location)
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("mean_lat", F.mean("lat").over(window_all))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("mean_long", F.mean("long").over(window_all))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("mean_lat", F.when(F.col("mean_lat").isNull(), F.col("lat")).otherwise(F.col("mean_lat")))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("mean_long", F.when(F.col("mean_long").isNull(), F.col("long")).otherwise(F.col("mean_long")))

# 8. Geo distance from usual location (Haversine approximation using simple Euclidean)
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("geo_distance",
    F.sqrt(F.pow(F.col("lat") - F.col("mean_lat"), 2) + F.pow(F.col("long") - F.col("mean_long"), 2)))

# 9. Category encoding
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("is_online", (F.col("category") == "online").cast(IntegerType()))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("is_travel", (F.col("category") == "travel").cast(IntegerType()))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("is_cash_advance", (F.col("category") == "cash_advance").cast(IntegerType()))

# 10. Amount log
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("log_amount", F.log1p("amount"))

# 11. High amount flag (top 5%)
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("is_high_amount", (F.col("amount") > 500).cast(IntegerType()))

# Select feature columns
feature_df = txn_df.select(
    "transaction_id", "cc_num", "ts", "amount",
    "hour_of_day", "day_of_week",
    "txn_count_24h", "amount_sum_24h",
    "mean_amount_hist", "amount_deviation",
    "geo_distance", "log_amount",
    "is_online", "is_travel", "is_cash_advance", "is_high_amount",
    "is_fraud"
)
feature_df.count()

# COMMAND ----------
# Write feature group
feature_df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable(FG_TABLE)
print(f"Feature group written: {FG_TABLE}")
spark.sql(f"DESCRIBE TABLE {FG_TABLE}").show()

# COMMAND ----------
# Create training dataset (no time-travel needed for this task - just use the feature group)
training_df = spark.table(FG_TABLE)
training_df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable(TD_TABLE)
print(f"Training dataset written: {TD_TABLE}")

# COMMAND ----------
# Train model
feature_cols = [
    "amount", "hour_of_day", "day_of_week",
    "txn_count_24h", "amount_sum_24h",
    "mean_amount_hist", "amount_deviation",
    "geo_distance", "log_amount",
    "is_online", "is_travel", "is_cash_advance", "is_high_amount"
]

train_data = spark.table(TD_TABLE).select(feature_cols + ["is_fraud"])
train_data = train_data.fillna(0)

# Train/test split
train_df, test_df = train_data.randomSplit([0.8, 0.2], seed=42)

assembler = VectorAssembler(inputCols=feature_cols, outputCol="features")

gbt = GBTClassifier(
    featuresCol="features",
    labelCol="is_fraud",
    maxIter=100,
    maxDepth=5,
    seed=42
)

pipeline = Pipeline(stages=[assembler, gbt])

# COMMAND ----------
mlflow.set_experiment(EXPERIMENT_PATH)

with mlflow.start_run() as run:
    model = pipeline.fit(train_df)

    # Evaluate
    predictions = model.transform(test_df)
    evaluator = BinaryClassificationEvaluator(labelCol="is_fraud", metricName="areaUnderROC")
    auc = evaluator.evaluate(predictions)
    print(f"Test AUC: {auc:.4f}")

    mlflow.log_metric("roc_auc", auc)
    mlflow.log_param("model_type", "GBTClassifier")
    mlflow.log_param("max_iter", 100)
    mlflow.log_param("max_depth", 5)

    # Log model
    mlflow.spark.log_model(model, "model", registered_model_name=MODEL_NAME)

    run_id = run.info.run_id
    print(f"Run ID: {run_id}")
    print(f"AUC: {auc}")

# COMMAND ----------
# Load registered model and score
from mlflow.tracking import MlflowClient
client = MlflowClient()

# Get latest model version
versions = client.search_model_versions(f"name='{MODEL_NAME}'")
latest_version = sorted(versions, key=lambda v: int(v.version), reverse=True)[0]
print(f"Model version: {latest_version.version}")

# Load the model
loaded_model = mlflow.spark.load_model(f"models:/{MODEL_NAME}/{latest_version.version}")

# COMMAND ----------
# Score the scoring dataset
score_df = spark.read.option("header", True).option("inferSchema", True).csv(f"{VOLUME_PATH}/score_transactions.csv")
score_df = score_df.withColumn("ts", F.to_timestamp("datetime"))

# Apply same feature engineering
score_df = score_df.withColumn("hour_of_day", F.hour("ts"))
score_df = score_df.withColumn("day_of_week", F.dayofweek("ts"))

# For scoring, compute card-level stats from training data
card_stats = spark.table(FG_TABLE).groupBy("cc_num").agg(
    F.mean("amount").alias("mean_amount_hist"),
    F.mean("lat").alias("mean_lat"),
    F.mean("long").alias("mean_long")
)

score_df = score_df.join(card_stats, on="cc_num", how="left")
score_df = score_df.fillna({
    "mean_amount_hist": score_df.agg(F.mean("amount")).collect()[0][0],
    "mean_lat": 39.5,
    "mean_long": -98.35
})

score_df = score_df.withColumn("amount_deviation", F.col("amount") - F.col("mean_amount_hist"))
score_df = score_df.withColumn("geo_distance",
    F.sqrt(F.pow(F.col("lat") - F.col("mean_lat"), 2) + F.pow(F.col("long") - F.col("mean_long"), 2)))
score_df = score_df.withColumn("log_amount", F.log1p("amount"))
score_df = score_df.withColumn("is_online", (F.col("category") == "online").cast(IntegerType()))
score_df = score_df.withColumn("is_travel", (F.col("category") == "travel").cast(IntegerType()))
score_df = score_df.withColumn("is_cash_advance", (F.col("category") == "cash_advance").cast(IntegerType()))
score_df = score_df.withColumn("is_high_amount", (F.col("amount") > 500).cast(IntegerType()))

# Compute velocity stats from training data (use simple avg as proxy)
card_velocity = spark.table(FG_TABLE).groupBy("cc_num").agg(
    F.mean("txn_count_24h").alias("txn_count_24h"),
    F.mean("amount_sum_24h").alias("amount_sum_24h")
)

score_df = score_df.join(card_velocity, on="cc_num", how="left")
score_df = score_df.fillna({"txn_count_24h": 1.0, "amount_sum_24h": score_df.agg(F.mean("amount")).collect()[0][0]})

score_features = score_df.select(["transaction_id"] + feature_cols).fillna(0)

# COMMAND ----------
# Get fraud probability from GBT predictions
pred_df = loaded_model.transform(score_features)

# Extract probability of fraud (class 1)
from pyspark.sql.functions import udf
from pyspark.sql.types import DoubleType
extract_prob = udf(lambda v: float(v[1]), DoubleType())

pred_df = pred_df.withColumn("fraud_probability", extract_prob(F.col("probability")))

# Write predictions
result_df = pred_df.select("transaction_id", "fraud_probability")
result_df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").option("delta.enableChangeDataFeed", "true").saveAsTable(PRED_TABLE)

print(f"Predictions written: {PRED_TABLE}")
result_df.describe("fraud_probability").show()
result_df.count()

# COMMAND ----------
# Create online table for low-latency lookup
spark.sql(f"""
    ALTER TABLE {PRED_TABLE}
    SET TBLPROPERTIES ('delta.enableChangeDataFeed' = 'true')
""")
print(f"CDF enabled on {PRED_TABLE}")

txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("mean_long", F.mean("long").over(window_all))

txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("geo_distance",

# Databricks notebook source
# MAGIC %md # Credit Card Fraud Detection Pipeline

# COMMAND ----------
import pyspark.sql.functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql.types import *
import mlflow
import mlflow.spark
from pyspark.ml import Pipeline
from pyspark.ml.feature import VectorAssembler
from pyspark.ml.classification import GBTClassifier
from pyspark.ml.evaluation import BinaryClassificationEvaluator

# COMMAND ----------
CATALOG = "workspace"
SCHEMA = "mlpab3f803c"
VOLUME_PATH = f"/Volumes/{CATALOG}/{SCHEMA}/data_volume"
FG_TABLE = f"{CATALOG}.{SCHEMA}.cctxn739ee9"
TD_TABLE = f"{CATALOG}.{SCHEMA}.cctd739ee9"
PRED_TABLE = f"{CATALOG}.{SCHEMA}.ccpred739ee9"
MODEL_NAME = f"{CATALOG}.{SCHEMA}.ccmodel739ee9"
EXPERIMENT_PATH = f"/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/mlpab3f803c/ccfraud_experiment"

# COMMAND ----------
# Read training data
txn_df = spark.read.option("header", True).option("inferSchema", True).csv(f"{VOLUME_PATH}/transactions.csv")
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("ts", F.to_timestamp("datetime"))
# Convert timestamp to unix epoch seconds (numeric) for RANGE window
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("ts_unix", F.unix_timestamp("ts"))
print(f"Training rows: {txn_df.count()}")

# COMMAND ----------
# Feature engineering
# 1. Hour of day and day of week
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("hour_of_day", F.hour("ts"))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("day_of_week", F.dayofweek("ts"))

# 2. Transaction count per card in last 24h using numeric RANGE window
window_24h = Window.partitionBy("cc_num").orderBy("ts_unix").rangeBetween(-86400, 0)
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("txn_count_24h", F.count("transaction_id").over(window_24h))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("amount_sum_24h", F.sum("amount").over(window_24h))

# 3. Historical card stats (all prior transactions)
window_all_prior = Window.partitionBy("cc_num").orderBy("ts_unix").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, -1)

txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("mean_amount_hist", F.mean("amount").over(window_all_prior))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("mean_amount_hist",
    F.when(F.col("mean_amount_hist").isNull(), F.col("amount")).otherwise(F.col("mean_amount_hist")))

txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("mean_lat", F.mean("lat").over(window_all_prior))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("mean_long", F.mean("long").over(window_all_prior))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("mean_lat",
    F.when(F.col("mean_lat").isNull(), F.col("lat")).otherwise(F.col("mean_lat")))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("mean_long",
    F.when(F.col("mean_long").isNull(), F.col("long")).otherwise(F.col("mean_long")))

# 4. Amount deviation from historical mean
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("amount_deviation", F.col("amount") - F.col("mean_amount_hist"))

# 5. Geo distance from usual location (simplified Euclidean)
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("geo_distance",
    F.sqrt(F.pow(F.col("lat") - F.col("mean_lat"), 2) + F.pow(F.col("long") - F.col("mean_long"), 2)))

# 6. Category indicators
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("is_online", (F.col("category") == "online").cast(IntegerType()))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("is_travel", (F.col("category") == "travel").cast(IntegerType()))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("is_cash_advance", (F.col("category") == "cash_advance").cast(IntegerType()))

# 7. Log amount and high amount flag
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("log_amount", F.log1p("amount"))
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("is_high_amount", (F.col("amount") > 500).cast(IntegerType()))

# 8. Night transaction flag
txn_df = txn_df.withColumn("is_night", ((F.col("hour_of_day") >= 22) | (F.col("hour_of_day") <= 5)).cast(IntegerType()))

# COMMAND ----------
# Select feature columns for feature group
feature_df = txn_df.select(
    "transaction_id", "cc_num", "ts", "amount",
    "hour_of_day", "day_of_week",
    "txn_count_24h", "amount_sum_24h",
    "mean_amount_hist", "amount_deviation",
    "geo_distance", "log_amount",
    "is_online", "is_travel", "is_cash_advance", "is_high_amount", "is_night",
    "is_fraud"
)
print(f"Feature rows: {feature_df.count()}")
feature_df.show(3)

# COMMAND ----------
# Write feature group
feature_df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable(FG_TABLE)
print(f"Feature group written: {FG_TABLE}")

# COMMAND ----------
# Create training dataset (full feature group for this task)
training_df = spark.table(FG_TABLE)
training_df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable(TD_TABLE)
print(f"Training dataset written: {TD_TABLE}")

# COMMAND ----------
# Train model
feature_cols = [
    "amount", "hour_of_day", "day_of_week",
    "txn_count_24h", "amount_sum_24h",
    "mean_amount_hist", "amount_deviation",
    "geo_distance", "log_amount",
    "is_online", "is_travel", "is_cash_advance", "is_high_amount", "is_night"
]

train_data = spark.table(TD_TABLE).select(feature_cols + ["is_fraud"]).fillna(0)

# Train/test split
train_df, test_df = train_data.randomSplit([0.8, 0.2], seed=42)

assembler = VectorAssembler(inputCols=feature_cols, outputCol="features")

gbt = GBTClassifier(
    featuresCol="features",
    labelCol="is_fraud",
    maxIter=100,
    maxDepth=5,
    stepSize=0.1,
    seed=42
)

pipeline = Pipeline(stages=[assembler, gbt])

# COMMAND ----------
mlflow.set_experiment(EXPERIMENT_PATH)

with mlflow.start_run() as run:
    model = pipeline.fit(train_df)

    # Evaluate
    predictions = model.transform(test_df)
    evaluator = BinaryClassificationEvaluator(labelCol="is_fraud", metricName="areaUnderROC")
    auc = evaluator.evaluate(predictions)
    print(f"Test AUC: {auc:.4f}")

    mlflow.log_metric("roc_auc", auc)
    mlflow.log_param("model_type", "GBTClassifier")
    mlflow.log_param("max_iter", 100)
    mlflow.log_param("max_depth", 5)
    mlflow.log_param("feature_cols", str(feature_cols))

    # Log and register model
    mlflow.spark.log_model(
        model,
        "model",
        registered_model_name=MODEL_NAME
    )

    run_id = run.info.run_id
    print(f"Run ID: {run_id}")
    print(f"AUC: {auc}")

# COMMAND ----------
# Load registered model and score
from mlflow.tracking import MlflowClient
client = MlflowClient()

versions = client.search_model_versions(f"name='{MODEL_NAME}'")
latest_version = sorted(versions, key=lambda v: int(v.version), reverse=True)[0]
print(f"Model version: {latest_version.version}")

loaded_model = mlflow.spark.load_model(f"models:/{MODEL_NAME}/{latest_version.version}")

# COMMAND ----------
# Read scoring data
score_raw = spark.read.option("header", True).option("inferSchema", True).csv(f"{VOLUME_PATH}/score_transactions.csv")
score_raw = score_raw.withColumn("ts", F.to_timestamp("datetime"))
score_raw = score_raw.withColumn("ts_unix", F.unix_timestamp("ts"))
score_raw = score_raw.withColumn("hour_of_day", F.hour("ts"))
score_raw = score_raw.withColumn("day_of_week", F.dayofweek("ts"))
score_raw = score_raw.withColumn("log_amount", F.log1p("amount"))
score_raw = score_raw.withColumn("is_online", (F.col("category") == "online").cast(IntegerType()))
score_raw = score_raw.withColumn("is_travel", (F.col("category") == "travel").cast(IntegerType()))
score_raw = score_raw.withColumn("is_cash_advance", (F.col("category") == "cash_advance").cast(IntegerType()))
score_raw = score_raw.withColumn("is_high_amount", (F.col("amount") > 500).cast(IntegerType()))
score_raw = score_raw.withColumn("is_night", ((F.col("hour_of_day") >= 22) | (F.col("hour_of_day") <= 5)).cast(IntegerType()))

# Get card-level stats from training feature group
card_stats = spark.table(FG_TABLE).groupBy("cc_num").agg(
    F.mean("amount").alias("mean_amount_hist"),
    F.mean("lat").alias("mean_lat"),
    F.mean("long").alias("mean_long"),
    F.mean("txn_count_24h").alias("txn_count_24h"),
    F.mean("amount_sum_24h").alias("amount_sum_24h")
)

# Global defaults
global_mean_amount = spark.table(FG_TABLE).agg(F.mean("amount")).collect()[0][0]
global_mean_txn = spark.table(FG_TABLE).agg(F.mean("txn_count_24h")).collect()[0][0]
global_mean_sum = spark.table(FG_TABLE).agg(F.mean("amount_sum_24h")).collect()[0][0]

score_df = score_raw.join(card_stats, on="cc_num", how="left")
score_df = score_df.fillna({
    "mean_amount_hist": global_mean_amount,
    "mean_lat": 39.5,
    "mean_long": -98.35,
    "txn_count_24h": global_mean_txn,
    "amount_sum_24h": global_mean_sum
})

score_df = score_df.withColumn("amount_deviation", F.col("amount") - F.col("mean_amount_hist"))
score_df = score_df.withColumn("geo_distance",
    F.sqrt(F.pow(F.col("lat") - F.col("mean_lat"), 2) + F.pow(F.col("long") - F.col("mean_long"), 2)))

score_features = score_df.select(["transaction_id"] + feature_cols).fillna(0)
print(f"Scoring rows: {score_features.count()}")

# COMMAND ----------
# Score and write predictions
pred_df = loaded_model.transform(score_features)

extract_prob = F.udf(lambda v: float(v[1]), DoubleType())

import databricks.sdk
